title: Battle of Kroya
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kroya", at revision 1370446326, opens: "The Battle of Kroyo was an engagement of the Java War which took place on 1 October 1828 near the village of Kroyo in Purworejo, in modern Central Java. A Dutch column, pursuing a small group of Javanese rebels, encountered a much larger force than they had expected, and was destroyed in a later ambush." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q133735807, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1828 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
